headwords: vạch áo cho người xem lưng

flags.why: The gloss conflates apes with an ape-like human ancestor, which is người vượn ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/vuon-nguoi-eIYxeb7jVr6hl.html)).
This is an old term for a stadium, so the untagged entry misleadingly presents it as current everyday vocabulary.
The example defines physics instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Cô ấy muốn nghiên cứu vật lí học. = She wants to study physics.
